body-classes: home-page

```{=html}
<div class="footer-nav" id="footer-nav">
  <div class="nav-buttons">
    <a href="/menu.html" class="btn-home">Home</a>
    <button onclick="
      if (document.referrer && document.referrer !== window.location.href) {
        history.back();
      } else {
        window.location.href = '/menu.html';
      }
    " class="btn-back">← Zurück</button>
   <button
  type="button"
  class="footer-nav-button footer-offline-button"
  onclick="openOfflineManager()">
  Offline
</button>
  </div>
</div>



<div class="zoom-controls">
  <button
    type="button"
    data-scale="0.9"
    onclick="setZoom(0.9)"
  >A−</button>

  <button
    type="button"
    data-scale="1"
    onclick="setZoom(1)"
  >A</button>

  <button
    type="button"
    data-scale="1.2"
    onclick="setZoom(1.2)"
  >A+</button>
</div>

<script>

document.addEventListener(
  "DOMContentLoaded",
  function () {

    /* ========================================
   Footer navigation state
   ======================================== */

const homeButton =
  document.querySelector(
    ".footer-nav .btn-home"
  );

const backButton =
  document.querySelector(
    ".footer-nav .btn-back"
  );


/*
 * overview.qmd is now the first
 * functional page of the site.
 */
const isOverview =
  document.body.classList.contains(
    "overview-page"
  );


/*
 * Has the user already left the overview
 * page during this browser/app session?
 */
const hasVisitedContentPage =
  sessionStorage.getItem(
    "has-visited-content-page"
  ) === "true";


if (isOverview) {

  if (!hasVisitedContentPage) {

    /*
     * STATE 1
     *
     * First arrival on overview:
     * only Offline remains visible.
     */

    homeButton?.classList.add(
      "footer-nav-hidden"
    );

    backButton?.classList.add(
      "footer-nav-hidden"
    );

  } else {

    /*
     * STATE 3
     *
     * User returned to overview:
     * Home + Back + Offline.
     */

    homeButton?.classList.remove(
      "footer-nav-hidden"
    );

    backButton?.classList.remove(
      "footer-nav-hidden"
    );
  }

} else {

  /*
   * STATE 2
   *
   * Any page after overview:
   * Home + Back + Offline.
   *
   * Also remember that the user has now
   * moved beyond the overview.
   */

  sessionStorage.setItem(
    "has-visited-content-page",
    "true"
  );

  homeButton?.classList.remove(
    "footer-nav-hidden"
  );

  backButton?.classList.remove(
    "footer-nav-hidden"
  );
}

  }
);

function setZoom(scale) {
  scale = Number(scale) || 1;

  const root = document.documentElement;

  const baseFontSize = 16;
  const baseGlyphHeight = 30;
  const baseGlyphRowGap = 7.2;

  root.style.setProperty(
    "--base-scale",
    String(scale)
  );

  root.style.setProperty(
    "--site-font-size",
    `${baseFontSize * scale}px`
  );

  root.style.setProperty(
    "--glyph-height",
    `${baseGlyphHeight * scale}px`
  );

  root.style.setProperty(
    "--glyph-row-gap",
    `${baseGlyphRowGap * scale}px`
  );

  localStorage.setItem(
    "site-zoom",
    String(scale)
  );

  document
    .querySelectorAll(".zoom-controls button")
    .forEach(button => {
      button.classList.toggle(
        "active",
        Number(button.dataset.scale) === scale
      );
    });
}

document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
  const saved = Number(
    localStorage.getItem("site-zoom") || 1
  );

  setZoom(saved);

  const cls = document.querySelector(
    'meta[name="slot-title-class"]'
  )?.content;

  const title = document.querySelector("h1.title");

  if (cls && title) {
    title.classList.add(cls);
  }
});
</script>
```
